migration.migration_reason: A preserved paid Semantic Compression metric shard with the same scientific experiment identity as the recertified owner was rebound to the current canonical catalog. Explicit legacy fragments, when present, matched exactly; the current metric validator re-checks the result.

gate_status.gate_note: This shard reports only the Quidra column. The runner is responsible for confirming the common-basis comparability gate across all 10 languages before this normalized figure is used in cross-language aggregation, per semantic_compression.md 'support_rubric.interaction_with_quality_metrics'.

evidence.interpretation_caveat: Every measured Quidra probe fragment yields B_i = 1 because Quidra's design deliberately forces the disambiguating information (mutability, aliasing/authority, initialization, overflow/failure mode, dispatch, ordering guarantee) into the mandatory local surface syntax at each of these sites (explicit const/&, single checked-arithmetic build posture, exhaustive match, monomorphized generics, documented ordering/atomicity guarantees). This is a substantive, citation-backed finding about the specific frozen probe set, not an assumed or default value; six probes where Quidra genuinely lacks the underlying capability (closure capture, array slicing, open extension, runtime abstract dispatch, user-hookable destructors, C-ABI export) are excluded from this mean rather than force-scored, and are instead reflected in Capability Coverage per the frozen na_policy.
evidence.methodology_basis: semantic_compression.md section 6.1.3.B: raw value is mean(log2(B_i)) over the fixed 44 probes, where B_i is the count of materially different interpretations (mutation, aliasing, failure, conversion, dispatch, resource behavior, control flow, representation, or observable-result differences) compatible with the probe's local surface form alone, before consulting external declarations. Lower raw value is better.

normalization_rule.description: Frozen before language-specific measurement (common to any language shard). raw = mean(log2(B_i)) taken over the probes for which this language has a measured fragment (FULL or PARTIAL support; probes scored NONE for this language are excluded from the mean, per capability_universe.json interaction_with_quality_metrics, and their absence is instead captured by Capability Coverage). Reference ceiling raw_max = log2(8) = 3.0 bits, representing a probe whose bare local surface form is compatible with up to 8 materially different outcomes (a level actually observed for bare-call-site aliasing/mutation in dynamically-typed or implicit-conversion-heavy languages under this same rubric). normalized_score = 100 * clamp(1 - raw/raw_max, 0, 1).

per_probe_branching.note: `const int n = 7` then produce n. Immutable value binding; Quidra's `const T value` form is a single, fully explicit, non-rebindable value contract (language.md 'Addresses, references, and const authority'); no alternate reading of storage/mutability/type is compatible with the surface form.

Module-level `int counter = 0` (mutable) vs a genuine `const int LIMIT = 100` (immutable named constant, distinct keyword). The two declarations are syntactically distinguished by the mandatory `const` keyword; no ambiguity.

`int32 v` with no initializer, both branches of an if/else assign it; Quidra's definite-initialization checker statically proves initialization on every continuing path (language.md 'Bindings and definite initialization'). Only one initialization/type outcome is consistent with the checked surface form.
`array(16)` yields provably uninitialized per-element storage tracked by a compact bitmap (architecture.md); this is the language's sole uninitialized-bulk-storage form, unambiguous.

`x += 1` on `int32` is Quidra's one arithmetic mode: checked, in place, single native build posture (no wrap/trap mode selection exists in Quidra); numeric-and-bin.md guarantees a single deterministic overflow behavior.

`xs[1] = 42` is in-place element mutation with runtime bounds checking; arrays have independent value semantics but element assignment through an existing binding is unambiguous in-place mutation (language.md Arrays).
`int &port = &slot; port = 9` is Quidra's sole writable-alias form; write-through semantics are explicit and singular (language.md 'Addresses, references, and const authority').
`const T[] &window = &xs` is the sole non-copying read-only view form; const-path write rejection is a static, absolute rule, so no alternate write-capable reading survives.

`ref.Cell<T>` plus `.same(other)` is the single deliberate opt-in identity-comparison mechanism (language.md 'Explicit reference cells'); ordinary `==` is defined to be structural, so `.same` unambiguously tests allocation identity.

Bare `f(x)` call: Quidra's grammar requires an explicit `&` at BOTH the call site and the parameter declaration for any writable or aliasing access ('Reference markers cannot be omitted or supplied to ordinary parameters', architecture.md). Absence of `&` at the call site alone is sufficient, without consulting f's signature, to fix that x is passed as an independent value with copy/value semantics and no retained alias -- collapsing the outcome set the spec 6.1.4.B probe is designed to expose to a single interpretation for this language.

`put(&cell)` with `int &value` parameter: presence of `&` at both sites is Quidra's sole writable-alias-passing form; the callee necessarily receives write authority to the same storage. Single interpretation.
`mid(xs)` returns `int`, a direct scalar value type; scalars have no storage-sharing representation in Quidra, so the return is unambiguously an independent value with no aliasing to `xs`.

Two results returned via a small class value (Quidra has no native tuple type; the class-return form is the single idiomatic multi-result mechanism, per llm-guide.md #26); field access at the call site is unambiguous.

`a * b + c` on same-typed `int32` operands: fixed precedence table, single checked-arithmetic mode, no implicit promotion possible (numeric literals aside, operands already typed). Single interpretation.

Integer `/`, `%`, and explicit `float(a) / float(b)`: Quidra defines exactly one integer division/remainder behavior and forbids implicit int-to-float widening, so the explicit cast is mandatory and the meaning of each of the three statements is fixed by the language contract alone.

`m + 1` at signed-32 max: Quidra has exactly one native execution posture -- Clang -O3 with checked arithmetic never disabled ('Runtime safety remains explicit ... not disabled for speed', architecture.md 'Native execution cost model'); overflow deterministically fails at runtime. No build-mode branch exists to create a second interpretation.
`a / b` with dynamically-possibly-zero `b`: DIVIDE_BY_ZERO is a deterministic runtime failure 101 in Quidra's single execution mode; only one outcome is compatible with the bare operator.

`s1 == s2` on `string`: Quidra strings compare by content only ('Class, array, and bin equality is value equality ... Strings compare contents', architecture.md); there is no operator overloading and no dynamic dispatch, so identity comparison is not a compatible alternate reading.

`int32(big)` explicit cast: Quidra defines integer narrowing as always range-checked, never wrapping or clamping (numeric-and-bin.md 'Conversion'). Exactly one outcome is compatible with the cast syntax.

`float(i) + d`: Quidra forbids implicit numeric conversion absolutely, so the explicit `float(i)` is mandatory and its rounding behavior is the single documented IEEE-754 conversion; no implicit-widening alternate reading exists.
`xs[i]` with dynamically out-of-range `i`: dynamic arrays are always runtime bounds-checked, deterministic INDEX_BOUNDS failure (diagnostics.md); single outcome.
`int | none o = none` plus `match`-based fallback: unions are exhaustively and statically checked, `none` is an explicit distinguished alternative; single interpretation.

No optional-chaining/map combinator is documented for `T | none` in Quidra, so an explicit `match` substitutes (R9/P-a); once written, the match is exhaustive and statically checked, giving a single interpretation of the substitute fragment.

`try int.parse(s)` inside a function returning `... | error`: `try` propagation is the language's sole explicit-failure-propagation form (language.md 'Error propagation and match'); single interpretation.
`match int.parse(s)` handling `int` and `error` cases locally: exhaustive match is statically checked; single interpretation.

`enum Shape: Circle(float) Rect(float,float) ...`: Quidra's named enum is a genuinely closed, per-variant-typed alternative set enforced by the checker (language.md 'Named enums and variants'); single interpretation, FULL support.
`match token` over enum variants requires exhaustive coverage with a compile-time MATCH_EXHAUSTIVE diagnostic on any omission; single interpretation.

`T head<T>(T[] values)` monomorphized generic function; Quidra generics are monomorphized before ordinary checking with an exact, non-erased declared result type T (language.md 'Generics'); single interpretation.
`T max_of<T: ordered>(T a, T b)`: the built-in `ordered` constraint is checked at the generic declaration itself (language.md 'Generics'), giving a single, declaration-site-checked interpretation.

No native fold/sum combinator exists for `int[]` in Quidra's documented stdlib (stats.* operates on tensor, not array); an explicit `for` loop substitutes. The loop's semantics (checked accumulation, in-order traversal) are single-interpretation once written.

`map.Map<string,int>` iteration and `.get("b")` on a missing key: insertion order is explicitly guaranteed stable (language.md 'map'), and `.get` returns `V | none` deterministically for a miss; single interpretation for both iteration order and lookup-miss behavior.

`file.Handle` release timing is explicitly documented as deterministic at end of lifetime on every exit path including failure, with no defer/manual cleanup required (language.md 'file'); single interpretation of the release point.

`print("x")`: `print`/console output are always-visible built-ins requiring no import (standard namespaces are always visible; language.md 'Modules'); single interpretation, no ambiguity about what enters scope from where because nothing is imported.

Quidra has no free-function/module-level privacy keyword ('private is a class-member-only prefix', language.md 'Classes'); a private class method substitutes (P-a). Once substituted, private-method access restriction is an absolute, statically checked rule (architecture.md PRIVATE_MEMBER), giving a single interpretation.

`task.all([twenty, twenty_two])` returns results in operation-array order 'independent of completion order' (language.md 'Structured concurrency'), an explicit ordering guarantee; single interpretation.

`atomic.Counter.add` is documented as a 'sequentially-consistent checked atomic read-modify-write' (language.md 'Atomic shared state'), a normative race-freedom guarantee quoted directly from the spec; single interpretation.

`extern int c_abs(int value) = "llabs"`: Quidra's FFI declaration form fixes ABI, by-value scalar passing, and calling convention explicitly and exclusively (architecture.md 'C FFI boundary'); single interpretation.
